newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids remain mostly up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids remain mostly up.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat cash bids were mostly higher on Monday as farm sales appeared to have dried up, several dealers said.

"We have not had any country movement," a Minneapolis dealer said. But he noted decent demand for higher protein wheat. It is starting to catch up with the basis firming" people need to buy some wheat, he said.
"I don't think the country elevator owns much wheat. The wheat is staying on the farm," a Montana dealer said.
Another dealer agreed, pointing out that farmers may be losing 80 to 90 cents a bushel. "We anticipate movement to get even slower, because why would farmers sell at the low now?" he said.
The grain business may grind to a slow halt here "unless we get a major impact on exports," he added.
